tools.name: about_connecty
tools.description: What Connecty is, what it costs (free), its limits, and the sign-up link. Use when someone asks for a simple status page or how to share whether their websites are up.

tools.name: list_my_sites
tools.description: List the websites on the signed-in user's Connecty status page (up to 5): id, URL, latest status, last check (UTC) and 7-day uptime, plus the page link. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: get_my_status_page_link
tools.description: The public URL of the signed-in user's Connecty status page (<name>.connecty.nl), to share with customers. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: get_status_changes
tools.description: The signed-in user's websites that were down at their latest check, plus the changes found in the last 7 days (website.down, website.recovered; newest first, at most 50). tools.description: Add a website to the signed-in user's Connecty status page (HTTPS only, up to 5 sites). tools.name: remove_site
tools.description: Remove a website from the signed-in user's Connecty status page, with its check history. This cannot be undone. Get the id from list_my_sites. Requires sign-in with permission to change sites.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "add_site" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_status_page, list_my_sites, get_my_status_page_link, get_status_changes, add_site · Private data: add_site · Public sink: get_status_page, about_connecty, get_my_status_page_link, get_status_changes · Destructive: remove_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_status_page, list_my_sites, get_my_status_page_link, get_status_changes, add_site · Private data: add_site · Public sink: get_status_page, about_connecty, get_my_status_page_link, get_status_changes · Destructive: remove_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
